items.title: George "Tex" Stephens Interview, 1995-07-21
items.q: Harry Lee was born and raised right across the street... Harry Lee, the sheriff of Jefferson Parish. He was running for government... Harry Lee was born right here in New Orleans.

ctx.x: It was on Ramport Street at the time. Ramport and Julia. And incidentally, Harry Lee was born and raised right across the street because his relatives had a Chinese restaurant right there on Ramport Street just about three or four doors down the street from Shaiky's Crazy House where they used to play the blues late at night. That's a true story, Shaiky's Crazy House.
I'm not... I'm just saying what a small word.
